sources.label: Independent SPI waveform and sample-time contract

traces.scope: 256-position, 16-capture model executing Compile.SPITransaction.program, checked against the finite SPI reference and independent elapsed-time waveform/capture contracts. MISO is the value consumed by input 0. Package sampling delay, RTL simulation, electrical timing and physical-chip behavior are outside this recording.

program.label: Assert CS / bit 7
program.description: Assert chip select, present the first MOSI bit and hold SCLK at its configured idle level.

program.label: Sample bit 7
program.description: Rising SCLK edge consumes input 0 into capture slot 0; hold commanded pins for four cycles.

program.label: Setup bit 6
program.description: Apply the next setup phase; no receive capture occurs on entry.

program.label: Setup bit 0
program.description: Apply the next setup phase; no receive capture occurs on entry.

program.label: Sample bit 0
program.description: Rising SCLK edge consumes input 0 into capture slot 7; hold commanded pins for four cycles.

program.label: Final idle-clock hold
program.description: Return SCLK to CPOL and retain the final MOSI bit for one half-period before deasserting chip select.

program.label: Halt / release CS
program.description: Complete the engine and retain all capture slots; CS_N becomes high, SCLK retains CPOL and MOSI returns low.

outcome.summary: Transmitted 0xA6 and received 0x96; raw capture register is 0x69 because slot zero contains the first wire bit.
